Name: Dacar Style for East Scarp SCA
Author: DacarTheGorilla
Description:
This really took me a while huh....[size=1] And technically I'm still not done ....[/size]

Finally here they are! ESR seasonal portraits, SCA version! Yes SCA version, cause I'm dumb enough to do all seasonal versions I could so there's 3 different versions out there.
This one can be considered the "base" of the others, since the others just add more outfits or change some that SCA has. This should work all right, some outfits may not appear, but that's mostly cause HDP not having appeareance support.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/6509pQY9/Next-Projects.png[/img]


Next mod will be:
- Catching up some old stuff, aka. Wedding receptions, maybe even redoing Vanilla...

After that I will be making one of this mods if I get the okay, pretty much in this order:

- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9999]Always Raining in the valley[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10770]Sen - Lurking in the dark[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6626]Lunna[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10016]Lavril[/url] (Maybe this one will have to wait till is back up)
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8606?tab=description]Juna[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31663]Eleanor[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13437]Creative Differences[/url]
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Never ending Adventure
[/url]

AGE Seasonal will be done some other time, I need to figure out when tho
